2) ACTION RULES — hard-fail (immediate rollback + page SRE Lead & Release Manager): error rate >0.1% sustained for 5 consecutive minutes, p95 >250 ms for 5m, payment success drop >0.05 absolute percentage points for 5m, any Sev‑1, or >1% pod restarts/failing readiness in 15m; borderline (hold-and-investigate): p95 increase >50% vs 5m baseline but <250ms, or error rate >2x 5m baseline but <0.1% — hold at current canary for 30 minutes, run trace sampling and error-log dive, escalate to SRE if not improving, then rollback if unresolved after 30m.

4) OPERATOR COMMANDS & ROLLBACK: promote canary manifests with kubectl apply -f deploy/payments-api/canary-step-<n>.yaml; snapshot Prom results via curl 'https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=<PROMQL>' or use ./scripts/snapshot-metrics.sh; rollback: kubectl -n payments rollout history deployment/payments-api (note previous revision) then kubectl -n payments rollout undo deployment/payments-api --to-revision=<previous-revision> OR ci deploy rollback --env=prod --artifact=payments-api:<previous-tag>, then page SRE Lead + Release Manager.
